direct.reason: Rhea lending is on NEAR; the beta has no NEAR wallet. Supply runs through NEAR Intents 1Click instead.

oneclickRhea.note: Supplies into your Rhea (Burrow) account on NEAR through NEAR Intents 1Click — no NEAR wallet, gas or chain switch. Withdraw on app.rhea.finance with the same wallet.
oneclickRhea.feeNote: Includes 1Click's 0.25% keyless routing fee. A one-time 0.60 USDC Rhea account + DApp registration fee applies on the first deposit only.

intentsConnect.reason: Intents Connect does not apply to Rhea supply.

note: Rhea (Burrow) lending on NEAR is data-driven. The rate is the contract's supply APR (variable), read live; supply runs through 1Click into your Rhea account. USDC only for now. Withdraw on app.rhea.finance with the same wallet.
